sheridan: Hey team, Sheridan here (PM, Growth). First day! Quick permission/help triage: 1) can't open Growth Figma board (403). 2) where's the canonical product roadmap + priorities? 3) who runs research ops so I can see interview templates? Appreciate pointers.

aisha: welcome Sheridan! :tada: For Figma try pinging design-ops or DM me the file link and i'll invite you. Make sure SSO looks OK too.
morgan: i've just added you to the "Design - Growth" team. Try the board again and tell me if it's still blocked.
sheridan: link: https://www.figma.com/file/GROWTH123/redwood-growth. Still 403.
morgan: sometimes SSO cookies get weird. Quick fix on mac: `open "https://accounts.redwood.com/sso" && killall -HUP "Google Chrome"` then reopen browser.
sheridan: tried that, shows access now 64c. Thanks!
aisha: roadmap is in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Roadmap (read-only for new hires). If you need edit rights ping @robbie or request via /access-request.
robbie: hi Sheridan 44b i've given you commenter access to the roadmap for context. We keep quarterly priorities up top: Serving-Core, DevEx, Observability.
sheridan: great, thanks. Research ops?
aisha: research playbook + templates here: https://redwood.notion.site/research-playbook. Research Guild coordinates recruiting and consent. DM research-ops for scheduling help.
morgan: also dropped a couple of interview script examples into the Prod > Templates page. i'll add you to #prod-research so you can see ongoing studies.
design-ops-bot: Sheridan has been provisioned into: Product Team, Design - Growth, Research Guild. New hire checklist updated: join crits, read playbook, set up tools.
sheridan: perfect. when are design critiques? would love to sit in this week.
aisha: crits Tue 10am PT and Fri 2pm PT. Calendar invites in #design-critiques.
sheridan: i'll join. Really appreciate the quick help!"
